question: Arjun and Malaika have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Arjun is driving at 140 km/hr while Malaika is driving at 65 km/hr. Find the time taken by Malaika to reach Kanpur if Arjun takes 13 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of speeds of Arjun and Malaika = 140 : 65 = 28 : 13

Since the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Ratio of time taken = 13 : 28

Time taken by Arjun (13 parts) = 13 hours

Time taken by Malaika (28 parts) = 28 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 28 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Arjun = 140 km/hr

Time taken by Arjun = 13 hours

Speed of Malaika = 65 km/hr
